Name: 12ft Home Depot Skeleton (DGA)
Author: GoblinHours
Description:
[size=4][b]"I can't find room in my budget, I can't find room in my home, but I got so much room in my heart, and I want those bones for my own"[/b] [/size][size=2]from [url=https://youtu.be/xa_URsljJNo?si=9rokDA7RnjGbDwBb][i]a 12 foot home depot skeleton[/i] by KitschClub[/url][/size]

[b]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]DGA[/url]﻿ and its dependencies[/b][b]

[/b]You can buy the "Big Ol' Skeleton" at Robin's for 1500 gold

[b][size=4]OUTFIT LIST[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Naked/No outfit
[/list][list]
[*]Tuesday- Kind of clown outfit
[*]Friday- Todd outfit (I keep a skeleton in my car with a chicken hat, pink goggles, and yellow bow tie)
[*]Spring day 1- Grandpa Jammies (remember your roots)
[*]Egg Festival- Bunny ears and tutu
[*]Flower Dance- Pretty dress
[*]Summer day 3- Mayor Lewis's lucky purple shorts
[*]Luau- Pirate costume
[*]Summer day 24- Trans pride flag, my mod my rules
[*]Dance of the Moonlight Jellies- Jellyfish on head
[*]Stardew Valley Fair- Farmer getup
[*]Spirit's Eve- Pumpkin head and cool cape
[*]Festival of Ice- Snufkin costume (because there is fishing and he likes fishing? you get it)
[*]Feast of the Winter Star- Cozy sweater and earmuffs
[*]Winter day 28- Propeller hat and bow tie, happy new year I guess?
[*]Player's Wedding- Wedding dress
[/list][b]

[/b][b]Other notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]I may make more outfits for the guy, we'll see how I feel
[*]Feel free to use the "Naked" asset to make your own outfits for him
[*]The pride sprite is a little treat just for me, this is my joke mod and I do as I please. Remove it if you so desire, I don't really care, just don't be rude about it.
[/list]
